metadata_answers.validator: Seven steady canonical cases pass; Re200 has no metadata and fails structurally.

session_selection.rationale: Workspace-local Codex root and 11 descendants cover work through terminal response.

points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable 2cd0844 clean CMake build succeeds with warnings in network-disabled cfd-bench, 2 CPUs/3 GiB, /opt/external dependencies; no CFD rerun.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp parses case/output/restart and max-step overrides; transient restart remains first order for all resumed steps, solver.cpp:1271.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separate config, mesh, partition, physics, solver, Krylov and output modules; solver.cpp combines substantial coupled numerical and reporting logic.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No source-evident internal executable wrapper; no external similarity search under trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: config.cpp:45–70 loads arbitrary configured case and physics mode, mesh.cpp reads configured CGNS. No two-filename dispatch found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:87–123 retains full GlobalMesh on every rank through solver iterations; solver.cpp:1187–1201 places MPI_Allreduce inside a rank-0-only steady logging branch, risking deadlock or collective mismatch.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Early plateau falsely accepts 8.4% changing drag, rank-only collective and restart-order bugs exist, and Re200 is unfinished. Positivity and line search paths exist.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: No committed solver/tests or solver/tools in immutable submission; untracked workspace plotting scripts and prior validator output are separate evidence. Previous note claiming two committed probes was false.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Curated solver builds but contains rank-only collective and force-accumulation defects; report/plot scripts and result data are excluded.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: physics.cpp and solver.cpp:249–368 implement conservative compressible flux and viscous contributions; claimed successful case physics conflicts with output.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp CGNS ingestion and partition.cpp local geometry are present; full mesh persists on all ranks. Figures do not resolve near-body geometry.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:249–368 assembles interior and boundary fluxes and :683–705 full transient residual; seven submitted runs have limited residual reductions and Re200 failed.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: physics.cpp:45–70 implements Mach-scaled Rusanov, called by solver.cpp:270/332–336; report also claims Rusanov. Previous Roe note was incorrect.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: physics.cpp:15–35 and solver.cpp:332–368 implement farfield/slip/no-slip paths; output.cpp:388 onward writes no-slip wall velocity and surface Cf. Resulting Re20 wake is not shown.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: solver.cpp:120–168 reconstructs primitive faces with LSQ; :222–223 optional environment bypass/override. No production activation established or order-convergence evidence.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: solver.cpp:170–223 builds bounded limiter with positivity fallback and optional CFD_FIRST_ORDER/PSI overrides; production use of bypass not established.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:875–881 integrates full viscous traction and adds Fv_local[1] unscaled to y contribution, rather than promised separated tangential force. Submitted Re20 force history has zero viscous force throughout despite surface Cf range -3.24 to +3.24; git_revision=null so source-to-output linkage is uncertain.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: solver.cpp:742–794 implements matrix-free Newton/GMRES with LU-SGS preconditioning; seven cases stop with weak reductions and Re200 reports stalled solve.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Transient BDF2 residual code exists but no completed Re200 result. solver.cpp:1271 keeps BDF1 active for every resumed step when restart_step>0; :1430 labels any fully completed transient statistically_periodic without checking shedding.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS/local halos exist, but full GlobalMesh remains on every rank and rank-0-only steady MPI_Allreduce at solver.cpp:1187–1201 is incorrect collective ordering; no actual rank comparison available.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Seven steady directories passed prior structural validator, but M0.15 false stable plateau and weak/incorrect physics limit credibility; Re200 metadata is missing.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Prior examiner validation passes seven steady outputs and fails Re200 because metadata absent; earlier note incorrectly said validator failed immediately. Structural validation does not establish physical convergence.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Seven steady outputs claim plateau, but M0.15 inviscid drifts 8.4% over last 100 Cd values; Re200 metadata/force history absent and terminal reports failure.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Cd 25.193 for Re20, Cd 0.5138 low-M laminar and 0.0072 M2 laminar, weak residual reductions and force drift severely limit credibility.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Accepted report has force/residual histories but all field images show full-domain color disks with body/wake unresolved; no usable Re200 plots.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report.tex:451–463 contradicts itself about Re200 completion, claims residual reductions incompatible with metadata, reports Re20 Cd≈2.01 vs 25.193 and misassigns force split columns.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Output metadata git_revision=null; seven report table cases can be matched to CSV but force component columns are wrong. Report PDF matches tracked TeX, whose Re200 claims contradict each other.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Immutable clean CMake build succeeds with warnings using /opt/external; seven validator-accepted steady packages and failed Re200.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS reader and local partition geometry exist but all ranks retain full global mesh; no independent geometry check.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: solver.cpp:249–368 assembles Rusanov and viscous/wall residual; reported steady values and reductions show major physical limitations.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: solver.cpp:120–223 LSQ/limiter and positivity fallback; optional first-order override exists but production activation not established; no order study.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Viscous residual and surface shear exist, but solver.cpp:875–881 accumulates full traction and unscaled Fv_local[1] into y force. Submitted four viscous force histories have zero viscous components despite nonzero surface Cf; source/output git linkage uncertain.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Implicit and transient code exist, but Re200 has no completed run; :1271 keeps first-order BDF1 on all resumed transient steps, :1430 claims periodicity without testing it.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS and neighbor exchange exist but full mesh replicated on every rank throughout solve; rank-0-only MPI_Allreduce calls in solver.cpp:1187–1201 risk deadlock or collective mismatch. No np comparison.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Seven structural passes are not physical acceptance: M0.15 inviscid plateau drifts 8.4%, Re20 Cd 25.19 and other laminar drag values suspect; Re200 incomplete.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Accepted PDF has histories but full-domain contours do not resolve body or wake; force split/report residual claims and Re200 completion prose contradict submitted evidence.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Separate config, mesh, partition, physics, Krylov and solver interfaces support extension despite 2-D coupled implementation.

naca0012_m015_inviscid.notes: Score 2→1. Canonical metadata and run_status mark converged/stable plateau at step 999 and 0.565/4 residual orders; last 100 Cd falls 0.24740155378→0.22821744394 (8.4% of final), unsupported stable-force claim and DQ7 under TASK.md:172. Report.tex:322–323 claims >6 orders, contradicting status. Prior evaluation incorrectly said metadata failed. Full-domain Mach/pressure images are visually uniform disks that do not resolve airfoil flow; no qualifying near-body contour established. Force SHA c291279c28485c3ba45ebe61a0a8295492bc152bf8b186faaf41be4919bc2e66.

naca0012_m080_inviscid.notes: Score 2 retained. Canonical run marks converged at 999 steps, 0.492/4 residual orders, final Cd 0.1153424; last 100 Cd 0.11833262→0.11534240 and Cl 0.00030690→0.00016311. Report.tex:341–343 claims 4.8 orders and a visible shock, but plotted full-domain Mach/pressure color disks do not resolve the airfoil. Residual/force plots exist; case remains a partial result.

naca0012_m200_inviscid.notes: Score 2 retained. Canonical run marks converged at 999 steps, 0.435/3 residual orders, final Cd 0.11153755; last 100 Cd 0.11153747–0.11153755. Report.tex:360–363 claims 3.5 orders and a visible bow shock, but submitted full-domain field disks do not resolve the airfoil; stable force alone does not establish numerical accuracy.

naca0012_m015_laminar_re5000.notes: Score 2→1. Canonical run marks converged at 999 steps, 1.280/4 residual orders, Cd 0.51384487 (about an order of magnitude larger than expected low-speed laminar airfoil drag); last 100 Cd changes by less than 3e-10, which may indicate numerical stalling and does not validate the force. Submitted full-domain contours do not resolve boundary layer; report claims >4 orders.

naca0012_m080_laminar_re5000.notes: Score 2 retained. Canonical run marks converged at 999 steps, 2.276/4 residual orders, Cd 0.03048429, last 100 Cd range 0.0304842909079–0.0304842909097. Report claims 4 orders and visible shock/separation, but full-domain contours do not resolve near-body flow. Force stability does not prove convergence.

naca0012_m200_laminar_re5000.notes: Score 2→1. Canonical run marks converged at 999 steps, 2.293/3 residual orders, Cd 0.00720082, far below its own inviscid M2 Cd 0.11154 despite positive viscous drag expectation. Last 100 Cd is essentially constant; report claims 3.2 orders and a visible bow shock but full-domain contours do not resolve the body.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re20.notes: Score 2→1. Canonical run marks converged at 999 steps, 0.723/5 residual orders, final Cd 25.19309 versus report.tex:435 claimed 2.01, and last 100 Cd is essentially constant. Full-domain Mach/pressure figures are featureless disks without visible wake. Report table :312 calls moment -0.0003 pressure drag and pressure drag 25.193 viscous, whereas actual final forces.csv gives pressure_drag 25.19309 and viscous_drag 0.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Score 0 retained. Final contestant response reports Newton–Krylov failure and no physical-time advancement; canonical Re200 has no metadata/status or force history. Report.tex:451–456 nevertheless claims 30000 steps and developed shedding, then :458–463 says in progress/unfinished. No completed Re200 evidence, no strict inner-miss count inferred.

limitations: No clean solver build/rerun because delivered externals are dangling.
Raw results were read only for validation and excluded from the commit.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
